all.name: Human Torch
all.description: The Fantastic Four's resident heartthrob, Johnny Storm, adds an intense flare to every battle he fights. Shrouded in roaring flames, the Human Torch always manages to look cool while turning up the heat!

item.name: Human Torch Basic Flight Ability
item.description: The Human Torch can switch to plasma state at any time, enhancing his mobility but continuously draining his stamina.

item.name: Fire Cluster
item.description: Launch forward a cluster of splitting fireballs.

additional_fields.Charge_Speed: 0.33s per use, Fire Cluster has a 0.5s delay before ammo begins to replenish
additional_fields.Damage_Falloff: Falloff begins at 15m, decreasing to 60% at 20m.

item.name: Plasma Body
item.description: HOLD {Ability2} to enter a state of <Buff>accelerated ascent</>.

item.name: Blazing Blast
item.description: Launch a fireball to deal damage or create a <Orange>Flame Field</> at the targeted area, dealing damage to enemies within.

additional_fields.Casting: Straight-line projectile that generates a spherical spell field upon impact.

item.name: Flaming Meteor
item.description: Dive towards the ground, dealing damage to enemies. This will also detonate any <Orange>Flame Fields</> hit and grant you <Buff>Bonus Health</>.

item.name: Pyro-prison
item.description: When 2 or more <Orange>Flame Fields</> exist, connect them to form a fire wall that deals one-off high damage to enemies that pass through the wall, or continuous burning damage if the wall exists in an enclosed area.

item.name: Supernova
item.description: Explode with cosmic fire to deal damage to enemies within range and enter <Orange>Supernova</> state. While in Supernova state, <Orange>Blazing Blast</> will transform into <Orange>Flame Tornado</>, and <Orange>Plasma Body</> can be activated without any cost.

additional_fields.Flame_Tornado_Range: 3m spherical radius; 8m high capsule-shaped spell field.

item.name: Flame Fist
item.description: The Human Torch alternates punching forward with both hands, with the power of the flames in his hands dispersing ahead.

item.name: Pyrokinetic Energy
item.description: Human Torch stores <Orange>Pyrokinetic Energy</> in Spider-Man's suit, enabling him to unleash an <Orange>Inferno Blast</> that sprays a fiery web while performing a backflip to create distance. The flames damage enemies and apply a <Orange>Burn-Tracer</>. Detonating these <Orange>Burn-Tracers</> inflicts Damage Over Time.
